payload.name: Sunwise

The app helps you organize projects, track leads, create proposals, and coordinate your team from a single, easy-to-use workspace. By centralizing daily operations, Sunwise saves time, reduces manual work, and gives installers better visibility into their sales pipeline and ongoing installations—so you can focus on delivering great solar projects to your customers.

payload.name: Recooty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recooty is an AI-powered hiring platform to create job descriptions, post to job boards, and manage applicants.

payload.name: Events Match
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Events Match helps founders, creators, marketers, investors, and growth professionals find events suited to their goals.

payload.name: Lumini

payload.name: MimikFlow

They can review results and conversations, handle drafts and escalations, adjust campaign settings, and add selected prospects while MimikFlow preserves the account's plan, permissions, and outreach safety limits.

payload.name: Candidate Time Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Candidate Time Extractor turns candidate availability messages into structured interview time details. It extracts available times, timezone, contact details, notes, missing fields, source text, and errors, helping recruiting workflows organize candidate replies faster.

The app is read-only and stateless. It does not schedule interviews, send invitations, contact candidates, update ATS systems, rank candidates, or make hiring decisions.

payload.name: First FMCG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: First FMCG is a B2B wholesale marketplace for fast-moving consumer goods (food, drinks, snacks, household, personal care and more). Buyers can search live stock offers across suppliers, compare normalized per-piece prices, view offer details, and send purchase requests — supplier identities stay anonymous until they accept. Suppliers can publish and manage their own offers directly from chat, including from a pasted price list. 0% commission, direct supplier contact.

payload.name: AuntBird Practice Management
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your AuntBird practice management account to securely access the business information you are authorized to view, including clients, engagements, time, billing, invoices, payments, expenses, and practice reporting. Access is controlled by your AuntBird account, firm, role, and permissions.

payload.name: Resimplifi Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Resimplifi CRE Data Search and analyze verified, accurate, and real-time commercial real estate listings directly within Claude. Resimplifi is natively integrated as an MCP server, bringing live CRE data into your AI workflow without switching platforms. Analyze communities, explore market availability, and move deals forward - all from one place. Built for professionals who need a faster, more sustainable workflow.

payload.name: Simmie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simmie turns what ChatGPT already knows about your business, plus any
materials you provide, into sales training your team can actually practise.

Describe the conversation you want reps to get better at and Simmie builds
the whole thing: the scenario, an AI buyer persona, a training module, and
the scoring rubric, saved to your account with a practice link you can share.

It also grades real calls. Paste a speaker-identified transcript and Simmie
scores it against your organization's rubric, saves the result to that rep's
record, and can build follow-up practice targeting exactly what went wrong,
then assign it to them.

Set your scoring standard once, in plain English, and every call after that
is measured the same way.

Requires a Simmie account. Monthly and annual plans are available.

payload.name: Gleap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Gleap brings your customer support workspace into ChatGPT. Search and triage tickets, look up contacts and companies, reply to customers or add an internal note, keep your help center up to date, and check support metrics without leaving the conversation.

Ask for the open high-priority tickets that are still unassigned, pull a customer's full history before you answer them, draft a help center article in every language you support, or compare this month's first response time to last month's. Sales teams can move deals through CRM pipelines, and product teams can search feature requests and survey responses.

Connecting takes a single sign-in: authorize with your Gleap account, choose the project ChatGPT may access, and you are set. Every action runs with your own Gleap permissions.

payload.name: Govly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Govly helps users find and analyze government contracting opportunities, awards, contacts, procurement signals, places, and contract pricing; manage saved searches and inbox matches; and collaborate in workspaces through ChatGPT.

payload.name: DigiTrust Evidence Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Review selected non-sensitive claims and source excerpts for security and procurement work. DigiTrust Evidence Assistant maps claims to supplied evidence, flags missing source details, checks exact quotations and supplied dates, and produces focused reviewer questions. Results help you organize a review; they do not verify factual truth, source authenticity, compliance or permission to share. Synthetic examples are also available. The Assistant does not access private workspaces, fetch source links, retain submitted review content in application storage, or approve external use. Share only material you have explicitly confirmed is non-sensitive and permitted to send to DigiTrans.

payload.name: Syntheia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Syntheia brings two things lawyers do every day into ChatGPT.

Compare: upload a counterparty's draft and your last version, and Syntheia returns a clause-by-clause list of insertions, deletions, and moved text, with a redlined document to download.

Query: ask a question about one agreement, a group of agreements, or your whole workspace. Syntheia navigates each document's structure, follows cross-references, and returns the exact provision text with a link to the source clause, so every answer is grounded in the document rather than in a summary.

Documents stay in your private Syntheia workspace, and results are scoped to your account.

payload.name: Breakcold
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Breakcold helps users find and update CRM records, manage tasks and notes, review inbox conversations and meetings, send messages, and configure authorized workflow integrations through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Icebreaker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whether you're hiring, selling, or searching, everyone knows that the best opportunities come from leveraging your existing network.

With Icebreaker, you can finally search across your own extended network, directly from your favorite AI tools. Turn cold leads into warm referrals and amplify your conversion rates by 5-20x when you make your agents network-aware, across LinkedIn, X, GitHub, and more.

payload.name: Worke
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Worke helps authenticated users find and inspect contacts, inquiries, contracts, assets and loans, calendar events, attendance status and purchase-pairing data from their company workspace, and answers analysis questions in one call: how a contract is doing (agreed price, invoiced, costs by kind, margin), what the company has with a customer, how a salesperson performs over a period, and how the inquiry funnel converts. Every tool is read-only and results are limited by each user's existing Worke permissions.

payload.name: Audiense Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Audiense Insights is an audience segmentation platform that looks beyond demographics to help you personalize at scale. Use it to tell stories that resonate, make data-driven creative decisions, identify insights about customers, discover influencer or partners, and more. ‍ 
 
Gain the ability to understand segments of consumers worth targeting and unlock cultural insights that can improve connection, conversions, and customer experience.  

This MCP connector is a product line extension that enables the creation and analysis of audience intelligence reports directly within ChatGPT, resulting in new ways to interpret and visualize the insights.

payload.name: Baukosten-Cockpit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Baukosten-Cockpit helps homeowners and project stakeholders view and manage construction projects, cost forecasts, estimates, offers, payments, and related documents directly in ChatGPT.

payload.name: 20Tabs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Running a hospitality business means your answers are spread across reports, dashboards, and closing sheets. With the 20Tabs connector, you can just ask ChatGPT instead.

Ask "What were my top sellers last week?", "How did April compare to March?", or "Show me all voided receipts from yesterday." You get a direct answer from your live 20Tabs data. No clicking through menus, no exporting spreadsheets.

The connector covers the full breadth of your 20Tabs account: sales and revenue reports, taxbreakdowns, daily and monthly closings, customer purchase history, receipt and payment details, and product performance. You can also manage your catalog, floor plan, and POS configuration through the same conversation.

Access is authorized through your 20Tabs account using OAuth. You control exactly which permissions ChatGPT receives.

payload.name: FileAssist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use this tool to work with documents stored in FileAssist using simple, natural language prompts. It allows users to quickly find relevant files, generate summaries, identify differences between documents, and extract key information without opening each file individually. This tool is best suited for efficiently reviewing, analyzing, and gaining insights from stored content within the FileAssist platform.

payload.name: Testlify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Testlify MCP Server enables AI assistants to securely connect to and interact with your Testlify talent assessment platform. Access and manage assessments, candidate data, test results, and recruitment workflows directly through natural language—streamlining hiring processes, retrieving candidate performance analytics, and automating assessment management without leaving your AI environment.You said: Tag line?

payload.name: Workleap AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask plain-language questions about your team and organization—answered with data from your Workleap account.

Instead of navigating dashboards, ask things like "What's our engagement score this month?", "Who is the new hire on my team?", or "Show me my recent recognition" and get a concise, visual answer.

What it covers:
- Engagement scores, eNPS, and participation trends—for your team or the whole org
- Employee profiles, hire dates, and reporting relationships
- Recognition cards you've sent and received
- Team structures and org context, so references like "my direct reports" resolve automatically

Built for managers and HR teams who want faster access to the signals already in Workleap, without switching tools.

payload.name: Tolstoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tolstoy brings your ecommerce content workflow into ChatGPT.

If you're a Tolstoy merchant, you can create marketing creative, manage your media library, browse your product catalog, build onsite widgets, and review ad performance without leaving chat.

What you can do:
  • "Create a square product image of our new ceramic mug on a clean studio background" — generate with the Studio creative agent, then refine it
  • "Show me my 20 most recent library assets" — browse, search, rename, and favorite your videos and images
  • "What stores are connected, and show me a few products from my catalog"
  • "List my onsite widgets and show me one's configuration"
  • "Show me my best-performing Meta ads from the last 30 days"

payload.name: Qualisend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

payload.name: Spott
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spott helps recruiting teams find and manage candidates, companies, jobs, applications, interviews, tasks, notes, outreach, and placements through ChatGPT.

payload.name: ProjectBase Beta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProjectBase AI Assistant helps you interact with your ProjectBase ERP using natural language. Access project records, retrieve project information, monitor financials, and perform day-to-day operational tasks—all from a conversational interface. New capabilities will continue to be added as the assistant evolves.

payload.name: Dockflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Look up ocean container locations and shipping schedules directly in ChatGPT. Enter a container number to instantly get port of loading, port of discharge, estimated departure and arrival dates, and tradeflow references.

Useful for freight forwarders, logistics coordinators, and supply chain teams who need quick container status checks without switching to another app.

payload.name: LegisRatio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: We provide a graph-powered infrastructure for programmatic access to an interconnected legal corpus of EU, Italian and Regional legislation and jurisprudence with precise temporal versioning. We empower agents integrating advanced semantic search, linguistic analytics, and real-time legislative monitoring into high-precision legal-tech and research applications.

payload.name: airfocus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your product context into ChatGPT. This app gives ChatGPT permission-aware access to your live airfocus roadmaps, OKRs, and customer feedback, so every answer is grounded in where your product actually stands. Query roadmap status, triage feedback, draft PRDs and stakeholder updates, and surface cross-team risk. ChatGPT can also create and update items directly from the conversation, writing straight back to airfocus. Make airfocus the product brain behind your work in ChatGPT.

payload.name: SCOUT for Federal Contracting
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SCOUT for Federal Contracting helps govcon teams search active federal and SLED solicitations, size markets from USASpending awards, track recompete pipelines, review GAO protests, and run executive agency briefings inside ChatGPT.

Search by container, master bill of lading, reference, vessel, terminal, status, hold, hot-load flag, or supported date. Retrieve a curated operational snapshot for a result, including milestones and current operational flags. Conterminal rechecks the signed-in user, OAuth client, workspace membership, and shipment authorization on every call. The connector cannot edit shipments, dispatch drivers, refresh providers, send messages, upload documents, or access another organization.

payload.name: Forj
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Forj helps gym members, coaches, and owners discover gyms and classes, manage bookings and workouts, review progress, operate schedules and competitions, manage programming and automations, and perform confirmed member, messaging, and billing workflows through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Aivie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aivie helps users search CRM contacts, campaigns, reports, segments, themes, and MJML emails, then inspect details or create and update private Aivie email content through ChatGPT.

payload.name: PKB Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PKB Immobilien is a locally focused real estate company specializing in Baunatal, Kassel, the Kassel district, and the Schwalm-Eder district. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties throughout the region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand location, infrastructure, and the surrounding neighborhood at a glance, making the property search simpler and more efficient.

Combining in-depth local market knowledge with personal advice, PKB Immobilien connects modern digital solutions with regional real estate expertise. Buyers, sellers, and investors gain transparent and convenient access to the property market in Baunatal, Kassel, and the surrounding region.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map view
* Quick orientation across Baunatal, Kassel, and Northern Hesse
* Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
* Focus on selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different locations and municipalities
* More efficient property searches through visual navigation
* Local market expertise and personalized real estate advice
* Modern and user-friendly access to the regional property market

Whether you are looking for an apartment in Kassel, a family home in Baunatal, a property in the Kassel district, or an attractive investment property in the Schwalm-Eder district, PKB Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and regionally focused way to access the local real estate market.

payload.name: Midlyr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Midlyr helps financial-services teams work with regulatory content, screen text for compliance risk, create compliance events, and track related analysis jobs from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Neria
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
**Neria is a 24/7 AI receptionist that handles your business calls automatically.**

Connect your Neria account to ChatGPT to check recent calls, manage FAQs, update team members, review call stats, and chat with your receptionist — all without leaving the conversation.

payload.name: beehiiv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your beehiiv workspace and work on it from ChatGPT.

Draft, edit posts and templates. Create podcast shows and episodes and read their transcripts and stats. Run communities: publish and pin posts, moderate reports, manage members and send invites. Build email automations, journeys and A/B variants. Manage subscriptions, segments, tags, custom fields and signup flows. Handle products, tiers, paywalls, orders, the ad network and the sponsor network. Set up recommendations, referral programs, polls and surveys. Read analytics for posts, podcasts and earnings.

Changes are written straight to your beehiiv workspace. A beehiiv account is required. Reading your data works on the free plan; making changes requires a paid plan.

payload.name: Meu Rastreio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Diga adeus às planilhas e abrace o poder do controle logístico simplificado. Com o Meu Rastreio, você conquista agilidade e organização.

payload.name: Pepper Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your Pepper Cloud CRM data directly in chat. Query and update records across modules like contacts and opportunities, log notes and tasks against them, check ticket status and details, and review quotations. Pull conversation summaries and sentiment insights, all grounded in your actual Pepper Cloud data. Learn more: https://blog.peppercloud.com/pepper-cloud-assistai-for-chatgpt/

payload.name: Threpoly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Threpoly helps operations teams understand the health, availability, performance and security of managed file transfers. Review current incidents, heartbeat and expected-file monitoring, SLA and performance trends, workflow and capacity tests, security recommendations, and safe SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS and AS2 trading-partner configuration. Access is read-only and limited to your organisation’s Threpoly data.

payload.name: GadgetOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold this month and get the real figure. Ask what is running out and get the items below their reorder level with a suggested quantity. Ask about one IMEI and get that exact handset: in stock or sold, its cost and its price, when it arrived and when it left, and the warranty left on it. Ask what is on the repair desk and get every claim with its status, customer, device, days open and estimate. Ask whether a customer's phone is still under warranty and get the determination from the sale date — or, where no warranty period was ever recorded, that fact stated plainly instead of a guess.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a device, change a price, a rack location or a reorder level, receive stock or one serialized unit, log an expense, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, book a device in for repair, and move a claim along to inspecting, estimate pending, approved, repairing, ready or delivered.

It searches a shared reference catalog of phones, laptops and accessories, so adding a product inherits the right brand, category, specifications and official image rather than starting from a blank row.

Everything is scoped to the single shop the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data.

Rejecting or refunding a warranty claim needs a manager PIN, and there is no tool for it — that stays in the app on purpose.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

payload.name: Comuro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Comuro helps real estate teams manage leads, opportunities, visits, agendas, and conversation insights from ChatGPT. Ask natural-language questions to find qualified leads, review recent conversations, check scheduled visits, and understand sales activity without switching tools.

payload.name: Terminal49
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Terminal49 helps users find and monitor ocean shipments and containers, inspect routes and transport events, check supported shipping lines, and create new tracking requests through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Shallon CSP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get accurate, citable answers about Shallon CSP (the trading name of Shallon Legal FZ LLC), a UAE-based legal, corporate, and fiduciary services provider based in Fujairah that serves clients across Europe and international markets. Courtyard AI operates this connector for Shallon CSP with the firm's explicit authorization and keeps its content current automatically, so answers come from the firm's own published information rather than stale third-party sources.

Use it for full details on the firm's practice areas: company formation and corporate administration; corporate services (ongoing governance, compliance, and corporate housekeeping); DIFC and ADGM wills, trusts, and foundations for expatriates in the UAE; cross-border structuring; dispute resolution; legal drafting and documentation; and regulatory compliance and licensing. It also covers who the firm serves, its office hours and logistics in Fujairah, and accessibility information.

The connector exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a canonical source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text, its canonical URL, and metadata. Every result resolves to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded and citable to source.

All content is public business information describing the firm's services. It is general information, not legal advice. No account, login, or personal data is required, and no client data is exposed. The connector is strictly read-only: it retrieves and cites the firm's published information and never performs writes, bookings, or transactions.

payload.name: nowo Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
nowo Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in the Braunschweig region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Braunschweig and the surrounding area.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surroundings at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With in-depth local market knowledge and personalised service, nowo Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Braunschweig real estate market.

Key Benefits

* Interactive map-based property search
* Faster orientation in Braunschweig and the surrounding region
* Better understanding of neighborhoods, infrastructure, and local amenities
* Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different cities and communities
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for an apartment in Braunschweig, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, nowo Immobilien offers a modern and transparent way to explore the regional real estate market.

payload.name: PuraFi Expenses
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PuraFi turns a conversation into a finished expense report.

Drop receipts into chat as photos, PDFs, or plain descriptions and PuraFi keeps a running list: merchant, date, category, and amount, organized by month or trip. Describe a drive ("office to the Hartford client and back") and PuraFi figures out the actual driving distance and applies the current IRS mileage rate, including the mid-year rate changes your spreadsheet missed.

When you're ready, PuraFi puts everything into a polished PDF report, plus files your finance team can open straight in Excel or QuickBooks. It double-checks every line for the things that get reports bounced back: missing details, forgotten attendees, duplicate charges. Then it sends the report to your approver with a one-click review link. No account or app needed on their end. After you send it, PuraFi tracks where your report stands (pending, approved, or rejected) and counts how many days you've been waiting, so asking "how much am I owed?" always has a real answer.

Use it for:

• Turning receipt photos and PDFs into organized expenses
• Logging business mileage at the current IRS mileage rate
• Building expense reports as PDF, Excel, or QuickBooks-ready files
• Sending expense reports to your manager for one-click approval
• Tracking approval status and how long you've been owed

Try: "File my expenses from this trip" - "Log my drive to the client site and back" - "Make my expense report and submit it to my manager" - "How much am I owed?"

From a pocketful of receipts to a submitted, tracked expense report, without ever leaving the conversation.

payload.name: Furgonetka
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Furgonetka umożliwia sprawdzanie danych o przesyłkach bezpośrednio w ChatGPT. Użytkownik może wyświetlić listę przesyłek zamówionych lub nadanych, listę przesyłek śledzonych i monitorowanych, szczegóły konkretnej paczki oraz listę dostępnych przewoźników. Aplikacja służy do szybkiego dostępu do informacji o przesyłkach i usługach kurierskich powiązanych z kontem użytkownika w Furgonetka.

payload.name: Quilia

Users can review setup status and firm settings, manage team members, locations, branding, FAQs, case types, audiences, automations, request templates, cases, appointments, messages, requests, documents, notes, contacts, employment records, and Quilia help content using the same access they have in Quilia.

payload.name: JARS LT

Our service allows developers and businesses to integrate official Lithuanian company information into their applications quickly and reliably. In addition to searching and detailing data on individual companies, the application provides tools for macro-analysis of the Lithuanian economy as a whole.

payload.name: Brava
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brava connects a business's loyalty-program data to ChatGPT. It can explain visits and recorded revenue, compare locations and busy periods, identify customer cohorts without exposing phone numbers or email addresses, review past announcement performance, and create prefilled announcement drafts that a person must review and send in Brava. If a user explicitly requests unsupported Brava functionality, it can record a private feature request for the Brava product team; it does not perform the unsupported action.

payload.name: Popl

payload.name: Sales Compass by Luzmo

payload.name: Pierview
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pierview helps users track and improve their brand's visibility across AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Deepseek, and Grok. Through this app, users can pull mention rate, ranking, and share-of-voice metrics, see which domains and pages are citing their brand, compare visibility and sentiment against competitors, review traffic sent by AI assistants, check technical AI-SEO audit results, read and update their brand kit guidelines, and generate narrated performance reports for any date range.

payload.name: upword
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
upword helps local service businesses get cited by AI tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, and Perplexity. This app gives agencies a way to check on that work without leaving the conversation.

Ask ChatGPT about any client. It pulls their citation data, recent content, incoming Reddit questions, and credit usage and gives you an actual read on how things are going. Not a data dump. Analysis you can act on.

Read-only access to your full client roster.

payload.name: SEOcrawl AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your whole SEO stack into ChatGPT. SEOcrawl AI connects ChatGPT to your live SEO data: Google Search Console performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, positions), GA4 analytics including the traffic you receive from AI assistants, and SEOcrawl's AI Tracker, which monitors how your brand appears and gets cited across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. payload.name: GETWAB Federal Procurement AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GETWAB is an AI-powered federal procurement and capture intelligence platform built for federal contractors, capture teams, and GovCon advisors. Ask questions in plain English to find and qualify best-fit opportunities, assess bid/no-bid decisions, research agencies and markets, identify incumbents and competitors, and analyze historical awards, subcontracts, entities, and exclusions. Continue your research in the GETWAB platform to explore underlying records, compare the market, and build a deeper capture strategy.

payload.name: HAVN AI Real Estate
payload.summaryOriginal: Top AI Powered Open House CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HAVN connects ChatGPT to your real estate workspace.
With HAVN, agents and teams can ask ChatGPT for scoped, permission-aware help with properties, open houses, contacts, leads, tasks, media, analytics, and seller reports. ChatGPT can find relevant HAVN records, summarize activity, prepare seller updates, surface property photos and files, and help create or update supported records when you explicitly ask.

HAVN is built for agents who want fewer scattered notes, cleaner lead capture, better follow-through, and a more organized workflow after every property visit.

payload.name: LegisGraph
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: We provide a graph-powered infrastructure for programmatic access to an interconnected legal corpus of EU, Italian and Regional legislation and jurisprudence with precise temporal versioning. We empower agents integrating advanced semantic search, linguistic analytics, and real-time legislative monitoring into high-precision legal-tech and research applications.

payload.name: Masha
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Masha is a campaign management platform for CTV, video and display advertising. Connect your Masha account to ask about your own campaigns in plain language: list them, check delivery and performance metrics broken down by day, device, geography, hours, age or e-commerce, and review the advertisers and publishers in your account.

Without connecting an account you can still browse Masha's public CTV inventory and rate card, and get the brand kit and pitch-deck structure used to build a media proposal. Connected users can also render a finished deck to a downloadable PDF.

The connector is read-only over your Masha data. It never exposes supplier costs, agency margins or any other tenant's data — every call is scoped to your own account by the same permissions the web app uses.

payload.name: SAMWAD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your authenticated SAMWAD workspace to review workspace status, inspect approved message templates, search masked contacts, estimate opted-in audiences, review aggregate campaign analytics and find inbox conversations. Access is tenant-bound through OAuth, and this public release is read-only.

payload.name: LoomaScale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LoomaScale helps users inspect connected Google and Meta ad accounts, review campaign performance and pacing, research keywords and search terms, create paused campaigns, and manage campaign delivery and budgets. Activating a campaign starts real ad spend; every create, activation, and budget change is validated against a user-configured daily spend cap.

payload.name: Gateway Tariff Calculator
payload.summaryOriginal: US import duty and HTS codes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calculate what your imports actually cost before you commit. Enter an HTS code and country of origin and get the duty owed, including every trade action that stacks on top of the base rate: Section 301, Section 232, Section 338, safeguards, AD/CVD and the rest, plus government fees and the landed total. You can also look up HTS classifications for a product, and see what changed in US trade policy and what takes effect next, each with its source. Figures come from the live US Harmonized Tariff Schedule and published trade actions, cited so you can check them. They are planning estimates, not customs rulings. Built and maintained by Gateway Lines, an FMC-licensed NVOCC and ocean freight forwarder, using the same tariff engine that prices our own shipments.

payload.name: growthroles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: growthroles tracks every open marketing and growth role across the companies that publish them, rechecked every night so a closed job is removed rather than wasted on you. It adds what no single job board has: employer-stated pay on thousands of roles, salary benchmarks measured across the whole market with sample sizes and dates, and a written read on each role. Ask in plain words, get roles ranked against your own CV, and track what you applied to.

payload.name: ecoExperten Energieausweis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

payload.name: EZFlow Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EZFlow Pro connects your contracting business to ChatGPT. Ask about your customers, jobs, schedule, and money — outstanding invoices, overdue balances, win rates — and create estimates and invoices as drafts. Every document created in chat stays a draft until you review and send it from EZFlow Pro, so nothing reaches a customer without your sign-off. New here? Try the built-in demo workspace — no account needed.

payload.name: UGC VZ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UGC VZ is a free directory of real, verified UGC creators in the German-speaking region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland aka DACH Region) with portfolio and social-media proof - no AI-avatar content. Brands search the directory by free-text query, city, topics, or verification level, inspect individual creator profiles, and deliberately request contact. UGC VZ then delivers the creators' contact details to the brand by e-mail; the directory takes no commission. Typical workflow: search creators, review a profile, trigger an outreach request, and poll its delivery status. Creator search and profile data never expose private contact details inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Lofty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connects to your Lofty CRM to manage leads, transactions, and communication history. Ask it to find or update a lead, check a deal's transaction status, or pull recent calls, texts, and emails on a contact — all without leaving the chat.

payload.name: Reckon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Verify email addresses directly from ChatGPT. Check deliverability, catch typos and fake signups, and flag risky addresses like disposables—all in real-time. Make email hygiene a native part of your AI workflow, whether you're processing signups, cleaning lists, or validating leads before they hit your CRM.

payload.name: HomePins
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 6,800+ RERA-verified new launch apartments in Bangalore. Get live pricing, possession timelines, builder track records, booking velocity, and commute distances to IT hubs. Book site visits or request callbacks directly.

payload.name: Trooth Network
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trooth is the trust network for the software economy. This connector lets anyone in a ChatGPT conversation look up a company's current, witnessed record on Trooth across nine categories, from identity and security to privacy, AI practices, and history, each with its source and the date it was last read. Read a company before you rely on it, compare two vendors on the same categories before you buy, take a live neutral read of a domain's public security surface, verify a signed Trust Ledger Token, or ask how Trooth works. A company can also look up its own record to see what buyers see. Every answer names its source and date, witnessed evidence is labeled apart from what a company declares, and anything not settled comes back marked unknown rather than guessed. It is read-only and returns only public data, with no account and no login.

payload.name: DiligenceSquared
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access DiligenceSquared market and commercial due diligence research. Search across a project's interviews in natural language, pull verbatim quotes with named expert attribution, and retrieve report sections and underlying data for any engagement on the platform.

payload.name: Iceflower
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Iceflower answers questions about retail merchants and their customers from a large North American consumer transaction panel: revenue and growth, store footprints, RFM customer segments, cross-shopping, retention, local buyer profiles, and shopping-centre rankings. Every tool is read-only and returns the same numbers the Iceflower web app shows the signed-in account.

payload.name: AgencyAnalytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgencyAnalytics is the only reporting and insights platform built for marketing agencies — and now it works directly inside ChatGPT. Connect every client's marketing channels into one place across SEO, PPC, social media, email, call tracking, ecommerce, and more, with 85+ integrations. Then query any of it, instantly, without leaving your AI workflow.

Ask about a client's Google Ads performance before a call, pull a cross-channel summary to spot what's working, or compare results across multiple clients in a single prompt. No login, no export, no digging through dashboards. Data comes straight from your connected integrations, so it's always accurate and up to date.

Your existing AgencyAnalytics permissions carry over automatically, so every team member only sees the clients they're supposed to. Setup takes under 60 seconds with no installation required.

101 connects ChatGPT to your workspace for financial analysis and project operations. Analyze company financial health using balances, income, expenses, transactions, bills, contractor settlements, and cost categories. Review and manage settlements and linked transfers. Search projects, tasks, comments, team members, estimates, price lists, and Wiki pages. Create and edit financial events, transfers, estimates, tasks, comments, and Wiki content.

payload.name: Sellergoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de

payload.name: FieldCamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FieldCamp connects ChatGPT to your field service business. 
Look up clients and job history, check schedules and technician availability, create and update jobs, build estimates and invoices, record payments, and track inventory — all from a conversation. Ask things like "What's on tomorrow's schedule?", "Which invoices are overdue?", or "Create a job for a client next Tuesday at 10am." Requires a FieldCamp account; every action respects your account's roles and permissions.

payload.name: Clootrack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clootrack's Genie lets you explore your customer-experience data in plain language inside ChatGPT. Ask about sentiment, themes, brand and product feedback, and complaints across your reviews, support tickets, surveys and social data and get answers grounded in your own sources, with verbatim customer quotes (citations) on request. Built for CX, product and marketing teams who need decision-ready insight from large volumes of unstructured feedback. No technical setup.

payload.name: Brief
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brief helps product teams and coding agents retrieve product context, reason over strategy, find and manage decisions, browse workspace knowledge, and connect the tools their team uses.

payload.name: Reacher
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reacher connects ChatGPT to your TikTok Shop affiliate program. Ask about GMV, creators, videos, samples and campaigns in plain language and get answers from your live Reacher data instead of a dashboard. Find creators across the open TikTok market, see who is actually driving sales, review sample requests and automations, and pull the numbers behind a weekly report — for one shop or all of them. Write actions such as creating an automation or replying to a creator are labelled and confirmed before they run, and money movement is not available through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Vedetta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Vedetta organization to review HSE observations and Daily Progress reports, get daily, weekly, or monthly activity summaries, search approved report content, and assess custom-field requirements. Vedetta remains read-only: suggested requirement changes must be applied in Vedetta.

payload.name: Social Bee by HYVE
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Social Bee helps registered teams plan, create, review, schedule, publish, and measure brand-scoped social content while respecting each user's tenant, brand, role, plan, Brand Kit, and connected-account permissions.

payload.name: VerticalResponse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VerticalResponse helps users search contacts, inspect contact details, manage contact lists, sample random contacts, export sanitized contact data, create and update draft email campaigns, send test emails, launch or schedule campaigns with explicit confirmation, and review email campaign performance from ChatGPT. The app supports a deterministic OAuth review demo account, uses explicit validated inputs for contact and campaign fields, never exposes credentials or raw API responses, and does not implement delete tools for campaigns, contacts, or lists.

payload.name: Whoovia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real estate agents and staff members within organizations can create and manage buyers for themselves or for agents on their team. Agents can also look up buyer and agent records by name and make updates.

Whoovia makes buyer profiles easier to manage, discover, and match within the real estate market. 

Try prompts like: 
• Create a buyer profile for Ethan Brooks looking in McLean, VA for a single-family, 4 bed / 3 bath, budget $1.2M, move-in within the next 3–6 months. Conventional loan, approved.
• Update Ethan Brooks' profile — set budget to $900,000 and location to Alexandria, VA. 
• Create a profile for Alex Morgan under agent Jamie Chen, looking in San Diego, CA — 4 bed / 3 bath, $1.2M budget, cash buyer, move-in within the next 2–5 months.
• Pull up the profile for Chris Walker.

payload.name: Gastrosync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gastrosync helps catering and hospitality teams turn inquiries into events, manage clients, products, packing lists, operational details, offers, agreements, invoices, and reporting, and safely maintain approved product-library data.

payload.name: Beentry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Beentry connects your beekeeping records to ChatGPT. Ask about your apiaries, hives, inspections, queens, tasks, honey harvests, finances and nearby-disease alerts in plain language — and log new inspections, tasks or harvests just by chatting. Every change is confirmed before it happens, deletions are reversible, and the assistant only ever sees data from your own signed-in Beentry account.

payload.name: Pace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pace is the context layer for your sales pipeline. It pre-computes deal intelligence from your CRM, emails, and call recordings, then serves it to your AI assistant as live, structured context on every deal. Ask what's really going on with an account, get AI risk and forecast assessments backed by evidence, catch deals that have gone quiet, and know precisely where your team is going to land. No more digging through Salesforce or HubSpot, no more guessing.

payload.name: Relay Tow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Relay Tow gives towing providers a conversational view of their operations. Look up active dispatches, check which drivers are on call, review driver performance, pull invoices and impound records, calculate charges against your rate cards, and generate reports — without leaving the chat.

payload.name: Proprietio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Proprietio connects ChatGPT to a property management portfolio so users can review operations, accounting, maintenance, and owner reporting in one place. It can generate a daily operations brief, command center, portfolio risk radar, and owner update; look up properties, units, leases, residents, rent roll, NOI, delinquency, income statement, balance sheet, and general ledger; manage work orders; browse approved vendors; and message residents or vendors. It is built for property managers, owners, and accounting teams who want to identify priorities and take routine actions without leaving ChatGPT.

payload.name: Inntally
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inntally is the operations platform behind bars, restaurants and hotels. This plugin lets you ask questions about your own venue and get answers from live records rather than estimates.

Ask what stock is running low, which suppliers changed their prices, how many covers are booked for Saturday, what a recipe costs to make, or how last month's profit and loss looks — and get figures straight from your Inntally account.

Access is read-only. The plugin can investigate, compare and help you draft, but it cannot change stock, place orders, alter bookings or post to your accounts. Those stay in Inntally, where they are approved and audited. It only ever reads the venues your own Inntally permissions cover, and if those change, so does what it can see. Guest phone numbers and booking notes are never shared.

You will need an Inntally account to connect.

payload.name: Conversion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to the Conversion marketing data platform to inspect CRM contacts, build emails, audiences, forms, and campaigns, diagnose why a contact did not receive an email or enter a workflow, and audit sync failures with Salesforce and other connected systems. Read-only tools cover contacts, opportunities, campaigns, forms, workflows, sync logs, and email performance metrics. Write tools create blast emails, audiences, campaigns, folders, contacts, and CSV imports within the user's authenticated Conversion workspace.

payload.name: CampusThreads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CampusThreads helps organization administrators run ambassador programs: review operations, coordinate events and shifts, manage tasks and resources, communicate with ambassadors and prospects, and configure their workspace.

payload.name: Kreel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kreel connects ChatGPT to normalized ecommerce performance data from Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads, and Google Ads. Users ask about revenue, ROAS, campaigns, creatives, email performance, and anomalies across their connected brands, keep a durable brand knowledge base, and publish hosted reports on request.

payload.name: LinkupAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Automate your outreach across B2B channels, right from your GPT. Find prospects, research people and companies, personalize and send your messages, send connection requests, and read your inbox and replies, all from your own connected accounts.

payload.name: Archive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Archive helps teams search workspace social content and creators, inspect campaigns, saved views, collections, operations, and webhooks, and manage those workspace records through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Yolando
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yolando spots emerging trends, connects the dots, and moves before the market – or your competitors – see it coming.

Connect your Yolando workspace to ask, in plain language, how ChatGPT and other AI assistants describe your business, where you're cited and where you're not, and how your visibility compares to your competitors'. Pull citation and reputation trends, track competitor movements, and get a prioritized list of what to create, optimize, or fix — all from your own workspace data, right inside the conversation.

Requires a Yolando account.

payload.name: Famulor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Famulor lets users inspect existing AI assistant configurations, saved versions, available models, languages, voices, and past conversation history in their authenticated workspace. This read-only directory profile cannot create or change assistants, start calls, send messages, launch campaigns, purchase phone numbers, or open billing flows.
